note: The same cube with a ToneMappedVolumeStyle: the colour is mix(warmColor, coolColor, N . L x 0.5 + 0.5) summed over the lights. Facing the headlight (N . L = 1) is the COOL colour (blue by default), the 45 degree edge band is 85 percent cool, 15 percent warm (37, 37, 218). That is the opposite of the classic Gooch reading and is what X_ITE 16.6.0 does.
gaps: the colours' alpha is not used (the voxel alpha stays)
